sanskrit: padyairdṛbdhaṃ racyate bhāskareṇaihuya upadeśa chuya bhaṭāṃsākṣirūpaṃ śiṣyate tacchānte śūnye'pyanāmayammvatuyaya ku/ha ta suya upadeśayatra sarvamidaṃ līnamupadeśaṃ paraṃ tu tatsuya mya raṭumasa nakṣatura sāthagaṭi raṭuma ta karūmasa thaphasphuṭaṃ dṛṣṭo mayā tatra citsvarūpo nirāmayaḥtamiya ḍyūṭhuya suragurunāthabhātamadvaitamanasastena dṛṣṭo'mareśvaraḥabuddhava gaṇḍaśata śata ditiyayairlabdho dehavanto'pi muktāste'nye'nyathā sthitāḥcaha kusa bvaha kvassa chuha saṃdehasvasyaikyaṃ ca tvayā tena kā āvāmiti saṃśayaḥsuha vā suha vā suha vā suhasaṃsārarogeṇākrāntāmavalāṃ māṃ cikitsatugaiya bhūra bhuvaḥ svara mīlitha katupṛthvyādīdaṃ gacchati kvāpi sarvamakṣara hiśīkhara kṣiśīkhara hyathayadi jñātamakṣaraṃ tattvayā tenāpi kā kṣatiḥśūnyasa śūnyāha mīlitha gauvadṛśyaṃ draṣṭā śiṣyate citsvarūpaḥjīvanta mari-tāya suya chuya jñānamṛtasya naivāsti na jātu mṛtyuḥcaha ṣana svāmī bvaha ṣyi muṣisa

sanskrit: niyoktā tvaṃ niyojyāhaṃ tasyāstītyāvayorbhidākusa deva aśvavāra pyaṭha ceḍyasapādayantraṃ tatra yogyaḥ sādī ka iti me vadasuya aśvavāra pyaṭha ceḍyasaanāmarūpavarṇo'jo nādabindvātmako'sti saḥśivamaya carācara jaga paśyājāḍyānmuktaṃ nīramādyaṃ śivākhyamkara manasa ta pavanasa saṃgāṭatadvyāptyarthaṃ prāṇacittaikyamevamakurisa svāsā mala kyāha pyayemālinyametyudāsīnaṃ rajobhirmakuro yathāke/ha na-ta ke/ha na-ta ke/ha na-ta kyāhagantavyameveha dṛḍhaṃ na kiñcitsuya chuya tattvavidasa abhyāsatattvābhyāsaḥ kīrtito'yaṃ budhendraiḥbvaha amalāña kasa kyāha mvaceviśuddhabodhāmṛtapānasvasthāśiva pūjana gvāha citta ātmasisvāhantvarāhuṃ grasate ca sadyaḥtuli tula tāya tūlu nā ke/haviśuddhabodhaikasvarūpamevatiha yasa tagi suha ada nyahālayaiḥ śakyate stambhayituṃ sudhīraiḥśaṃkara labuma tamiya sātīmanaśca dagdhvā śivadhāma labdham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00032 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇa apāna phuṭaritha pakhacyanodena vāyudvayapakṣarodhātsuha no pacu tāya dhanyā lūsitisa mukto nottamarṇādyo gṛhṇātyarthaṃ hi so'nṛṇaḥcitā dehasa vāna kyāha vanamano vivekitāṃ neyamalaṃ bhogānucintanaiḥtoti chuya durlabha sahaja-vicāratathaikatāptāvapi naiṣa labhyaḥśūnyasa śūnyāha mīlitha gauvatasmāttvaṃ tadbhedabuddhirvṛthaivasoruya suya tāya bvaha nava ke/hanāhaṃ na tvaṃ naiva cāyaṃ prapañcaḥke/h chiya gṛha bajitha akriyabhuktvā striyaṃ cāpyaparaḥ supūtaḥtasa sāsa mantara kyāha jana karekiṃ tasyānyairmantravṛndairvidheyammṛtāmṛte māṃ prati tulyarūpepānaya deva ta arcuna kasayasyātmabhūtaḥ sa kamarcayed budhaḥdeśakha dūryā dramana nīliyardūrvāsthalaṃ bhātyatinīlamārātsuha saṃsārasa jyayi na nechana pīḍayati saṃsāre saphalaṃ cāsya jīvitamantiha sakalu kapaṭa-caryathasarvaṃ caitajjṛmbhitaṃ kaitavasya
source_edition: Muktabodha M00032 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kavasana mantra śaṃkara vujemaṃtraśca kastatra vada prayojyaḥchvapi maṃtra śaṃkara vujemaunākhyamaṃtreṇa samarcayeśamucchvāsamātreṇa dhṛtiṃ bhajāmicaya chukha soruya ta lāgijiya kyāhatvatpūjārthaṃ naiva kiṃcillabhe'hamtamiya soruya vyanduna svāsasarvaṃ tyaktvā bhasmavadbhāvajātammya cya-ta pānasa dituma chvahajñātvādya viśrāntimupāgatā tvāmsaya dapije sahajā kriyasmṛtyārcyate yena viśuddha ātmāniśa chuya ta parjānatanakṛtaṃ pradeśāntaramārgaṇenajyana nā jyana ta tatuya pyanayāvatpramāṇaṃ khalu dehijātamsvāntarniviṣṭā khalu tadvimarśepyali dali trāvimasa tatiyalalleti loke prathitā tadāhamsati nya/gi sarasa śūnyākārasmarāmi śūnyaṃ khalu saptavāramśiva chuya krūṭhu-tāya cena upadeśakaṣṭena labhyaṃ śṛṇu taṃ guroḥ śivamśiva chuya krūṭhu tāya cena upadeśa
source_edition: Muktabodha M00032 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaṣṭena labhyaṃ śṛṇu taṃ guroḥ śivamśiva chuya krūṭu-tāya cena upadeśakaṣṭena labhyaṃ śṛṇu taṃ guroḥ śivamśiva chuya krūṭhu tāya cena upadeśakaṣṭena labhyaṃ śṛṇu taṃ guroḥ śivamkyā chuya maluna sūra tāya sāsayathāsthitastvaṃ paramo'styupāyaḥhūha kava tarunu ta hāha kava tatuvuṣṇo'sti hāh kimatha hūh suśītaḥtavaya tarunu hūha hāha gauva tatusiddhānta evaṃ munibhiḥ pradiṣṭaḥsuya paramaśivuna tanatharadravyaṃ tadevāsti mamātra tantramgaya sata laya para paśithavismārya līnaṃ svamivātra sadbhiḥbari bari bāna ta cyavāna na ku/hapūrṇānyeva tathāpi tatra vimukhaḥ prāpto janaḥ śocitaḥślokānāṃ bhāskareṇeha dṛbdhamastu śivārpaṇam
